title: The German Weekend
label: ch:ge-wochenende
canDo: I can name both German words for Saturday and the word for Sunday, and say which of them German inherited and which it bought.

payoff.summary: The weekend is where the weekday pattern breaks a second time. Samstag is not Saturn's day but the Sabbath — Hebrew shabbāt by way of Greek — while Sonntag is the sun's, a day the Church renamed in Romance and left alone here. It closes on Sonnabend, the northern Saturday, which is transparent the moment Sonne and Abend are both owned.
